metadata.description: Pay with a QR code and earn rewards instantly, in your own currency.

landing.tagline: Pay and earn rewards at your favorite shops.
landing.createWarning: If you already had an account, sign in with your previous passkey to access your balance.
landing.otherDeviceHint: On the next screen, choose the option to use a passkey from another phone or a security key.
landing.signedInBody: You're in. We're getting your balance and rewards ready.

register.title: Create your account
register.description: Two details and your fingerprint. No password needed.
register.alreadyHaveAccount: Already had an account? Sign in with your fingerprint to get your balance back instead of creating another one.
register.name: Your name
register.nameError: Enter a name between 2 and 40 characters.
register.emailHint: We keep it as your account's contact detail.
register.fingerprintNotice: You will confirm with your fingerprint next. That fingerprint is your account key: we never store a password.
register.profileFailed: We created your account, but we couldn't save your name and email.

newMerchant.title: Register your business
newMerchant.description: Find your place and confirm the details. It can take payments right away: nobody has to approve it.
newMerchant.searchHint: Pick your place from the list and we fill the details in. You can also type them by hand.
newMerchant.searchDown: The search is unavailable right now. Fill the details in by hand and carry on.
newMerchant.name: Business name
newMerchant.nameError: Enter a name between 2 and 60 characters.
newMerchant.categoryError: Pick a category from the list.
newMerchant.countryError: Enter the country as two letters, for example AR.
newMerchant.emailError: Enter a valid email address or leave it empty.
newMerchant.confirmation: You will use your fingerprint once. That enables your business to take payments.
newMerchant.personAddress: This is already your personal account. Register your business from the Home menu.
newMerchant.activationFailed: We couldn't enable your business. Try again in a moment.
newMerchant.doneTitle: Done! Your business can take payments
newMerchant.doneBody: Create your first charge and show the code to your customer.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.wrongAccount: That passkey belongs to another account. Choose this account's passkey.
errors.network: We couldn't reach RewApp. Check your connection and try again.
errors.passkeyFailed: We couldn't read your passkey. Try again or use another device.
errors.prfUnavailable: This passkey manager doesn't work with RewApp. Try Google's or Apple's, or another device.
errors.browserUnsupported: Your browser doesn't support RewApp. Update it or try another one.
errors.backupFailed: We couldn't open your backup passkey. Try your main passkey.
errors.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Sign in again with your passkey.

money.simulatedFx: Simulated exchange rate for the demo.

session.confirmBody: For your security we paused your session. Use your fingerprint or face to continue.

home.protectBody: Add a backup passkey in case you lose this phone.
home.noMerchants: Pay with RewApp at a store and your visits and rewards will show up here.
home.visitsLeft: {count, plural, one {# more visit to your reward} other {# more visits to your reward}}
home.loadError: We couldn't update your balance. Try again.

topUp.title: Add money
topUp.limit: You can add up to {amount} at a time.
topUp.simulated: This is a test top-up: no real money is charged.

errors.rateLimited: Too many top-ups in a row. Try again in a while.
errors.outOfRange: That amount is over the limit per top-up.
errors.failed: We couldn't add money. Try again.
errors.serviceUnavailable: We can't add money right now. Please try again in a few minutes.

topUp.successHint: Your balance is ready for your next payment.

backup.title: Protect your balance
backup.body: Add a backup passkey on another device or a security key. If you lose this phone, the backup gets you into the same account.
backup.hint: First confirm with your usual fingerprint, then create the new passkey. To use another phone, choose "Use another device".
backup.doneBody: You can now sign in with either of your two passkeys.

redeem.title: Redeem
redeem.soon: Soon you'll be able to redeem your RewPoints for rewards.

scan.imageInvalid: Choose an image up to 20 MB.
scan.imageNoQr: No QR code was found in that image. Try a clearer image.
scan.title: Scan
scan.body: Point the camera at the store's QR code.
scan.notRewApp: That QR code isn't from RewApp.

errors.denied: We need permission to use the camera. Allow it in your browser and try again.

cardSelector.title: Your cards
cardSelector.description: Keep your cards handy for your next payments.
cardSelector.payTitle: How would you like to pay?
cardSelector.payDescription: Choose a method to continue with your payment.
cardSelector.emptyDescription: Once you add a card, it will appear here.
cardSelector.loadError: We couldn’t load your cards. Please try again.

pay.slideHelp: Drag the handle to the right end and release to confirm. With a keyboard, press Enter or Space. Escape cancels the slide.
pay.cardUnavailable: Card payments will be available later. For now, choose your RewApp balance.

closed.paidHint: You can view the receipt from the account that made the payment.
closed.hint: Ask the store to show you a new QR code.

errors.expired: This charge expired. Ask the store for a new QR code.
errors.overLimit: You went over the limit per payment or per day.
errors.passkey: We couldn't confirm it's you. Try again.
errors.failed: We couldn't make the payment. Try again.
errors.serviceUnavailable: We can't process payments right now. Please try again in a few minutes.

receipt.shareError: We could not share your receipt. You can save a PDF using the print button.
receipt.title: Receipt
receipt.error: We could not retrieve your receipt. Check that the operation is confirmed and you are using the corresponding account.

addCard.title: Add a card
addCard.description: Save your card to your account.
addCard.notice: We register identifying card details. Card payments are not available yet.
addCard.confirmation: Confirm with your passkey. We save the brand, last four digits, cardholder name and expiry.
addCard.duplicate: This card is already linked to your account. You can choose another.
addCard.doneBody: Your card is saved to your account. Card payments are not available yet.
addCard.numberHint: Enter only the last four digits.
addCard.holderError: Enter a name between 2 and 80 characters.
addCard.expiryError: Enter MM/YY after the current month, with a month from 01 to 12 and no more than 20 years ahead.
addCard.invalidDetails: Check the last four digits, cardholder name and unexpired date.
addCard.saveError: We could not save your card. Please try again.

demoCharge.title: Test charge
demoCharge.description: Café Demo · ARS 5,000. Scan the QR with another account or open the payment here. For testing only.
demoCharge.qrAlt: QR code for the Café Demo test charge
demoCharge.expired: This QR code has expired. Generate another to keep testing.
demoCharge.error: We couldn’t generate the charge. Check that the database is available and try again.
